project_context.summary: A dated basement kitchen and family room under the Bountiful Pool House. The lighted ceiling came out and the ceiling went up to the ductwork, a window was cut through the brick over the sink, and the space was filled with can lights. Alder cabinets by the family's own cabinet maker, a brick pattern backsplash that runs up and around and only looks beveled, a black composite farmhouse sink, a faucet whose pull down disappears into the back, a microwave behind a lift up cabinet door, and a family room with a built in entertainment cabinet, surround sound and a two step crown.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short from the finished walkthrough, 11:08 to 13:51, plus one before beat from the pre demo tour at 1:01.
project_context.publish_order: Single Short per episode. It links to the re-uploaded long video, We Cut a Window Through Solid Brick.
notes: The microwave is the hook. It is the one feature a viewer cannot see in the wide, which is the point of the first line.
The window gets one feature line only. It is the long video's hook and the end card sends people there for the full story.

shorts.full_vo:
This basement kitchen has a microwave you will never see. It sits behind a cabinet door that lifts up out of the way. Before, it was dark and dated, under an old lighted ceiling.

We tore that ceiling out, raised it, and filled it with can lights. Alder cabinets, by the family's own cabinet maker. Then we cut a window in over the sink for daylight.

Black farmhouse sink, and the faucet hides its own pull down. The backsplash runs up and around, and it only looks beveled. The family room got a built in entertainment cabinet and surround sound. And a two step crown that is really baseboard turned upside down.
shorts.voice_direction: Warm and unhurried, a contractor quietly enjoying the hidden microwave, showing a friend round a room he is proud of.
